title: Recommendation strength review: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
audience: Function managers, CAPA designers and HSE leads
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Of the register's 3 recommendations, 2 are stronger and 1 is intermediate; none is weaker, and no learning is flagged as a weak fix for a deep cause.
All 3 changes are single-loop, and none cites the finding it answers.

items.text: This review covers the learnings register: 3 recommendations across 2 learnings. There is no 9M analysis for this investigation, so the spread across the nine Ms is not shown.

sections.heading: Strength of change for each learning

items.text: All 3 changes are single-loop: each fixes the condition, and none questions the assumption behind it. The register marks LR-02 as double-loop, yet its change adds a shutdown without asking why the alarm was designed to display only.

items.change: Question the design basis that let a gas alarm only display: review which other alarms on the unit inform without acting, and give each a defined automatic or operator response.
items.indicator: Share of the unit's safety alarms with a defined and tested response
items.why_not_stronger: The engineering change for this alarm is already in the register; this direction questions the rule that produced it.
